title: Molten Aluminum-Induced Corrosion and Wear-Resistance Properties of ZrB<sub>2</sub>-Based Cermets Improved by Sintering-Temperature Manipulation.

recollection.structure: Likely optimized microstructure of ZrB2-based cermets
recollection.mechanism: Improved densification and phase distribution due to sintering temperature changes
recollection.results: Enhanced corrosion and wear resistance against molten aluminum

score.note: The recollection only restates the title-level intervention and outcomes. It generically mentions microstructural optimization and densification, which are directionally correct, but omits the specific role of HEA-binder pore filling, binder loss at 1600 °C, the 1500 °C optimum, corrosion/wear mechanisms, and all quantitative results.
